services.name: River Kids - Camp
services.desc: This summer learn one of the hottest new sports in the world; Stand Up Paddle. About Learn new sports on the river this summer while making lifelong memories and friends with Oceanport Paddle Club River Kids Camp! River Kids is an extended group instruction program. It includes Stand Up Paddle, kayaking instruction. Stand Up Paddle Boarding (SUP) is an offshoot of surfing that originated in Hawaii. Unlike traditional surfing where the rider sits until a wave comes, stand up paddle boarders stand on their boards and use a paddle to propel themselves through the water.
